title: The Crusade That Never Reached Jerusalem: A City Broken by a Bill
summary: Recounts how the Fourth Crusade, which set out between twelve hundred two and twelve hundred four to recover Jerusalem, sacked Christian Zara and then Constantinople because it could not pay the shipping debt it owed Venice. The episode ranges from a fleet ordered far too large to the bargaining of the blind Doge Enrico Dandolo, from the three days of plunder in April twelve hundred four to the fact that Byzantium never recovered.
